question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable narrow `ContextEngine.assemble` contract now, or fold token accounting into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: This is a public plugin API and SDK export surface that third-party context engines may compile against, and a broader related API proposal remains open.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this focused token-count API now, then require the SDK baseline update and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into Broader RFC
options.body: Pause or close this branch and design token counts together with provenance/internal-event assemble metadata in the open RFC.

options.title: Keep Helpers Private For Now
options.body: Avoid SDK runtime helper exports until maintainers settle what token-budgeting API should be stable for plugin authors.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this focused token-count API now, then require the SDK baseline update and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have the most recent merged history on the exact context-engine budget path.
